name: Corning Incorporated
live_basis: IBKR conid 7655, 08-03 after-hours $149.65 (+2.05% on a $146.64 regular close); IV 80.6% annual
plan: NO POSITION at spot. Watch with a price gate: alert below $95 (~22x FY27 core EPS). State honestly that $95 is below the 13w low of $114.50 and would most likely only print INSIDE the AI break - at which point FY27 estimates fall too, so the gate is largely self-defeating. Do NOT enter on day 2 of a broker-upgrade bounce inside a -46% month at 80.6% IV. Household already ~26% AI-complex; this would concentrate the book's most fragile axis.
catalyst: Q3 2026 print 2026-10-27 (verified, no blackout conflict). Guide is core sales $4.9-5.0bn / core EPS $0.85-0.89.
kill_triggers: Optical Communications y/y growth decelerates below +15% for two consecutive quarters
Amazon or NVIDIA capacity commitments re-phased in an 8-K
FY27 core EPS consensus falls below $3.80
edge_explainer: The only genuine DE-RATE in the cohort by the contract's own test - and still a reject on price. Q2 (2026-07-28): core sales $4.74bn +17%, core EPS $0.78 +30%, Optical Communications $2.07bn +32% with Enterprise Networks +65%, core gross margin 39.6% (+120bps), core operating margin 20.9% (+190bps), Q3 guided to +16% sales / +28% EPS, announced alongside a multiyear multibillion-dollar Amazon supply agreement and an NVIDIA partnership to expand US optical capacity ~10x. Consensus ROSE through the crash (FY26 core EPS $3.171 -> $3.265, FY27 $4.042 -> $4.305 over 90 days). The stock fell 12-16% on the print and -46% over July, its worst month in 24 years. The microstructure signal is the finding: the market has stopped paying for AI-optical good news, and it showed up first in the picks-and-shovels layer. AI-BREAK CONFLICT, stated not averaged: the entry REQUIRES the cycle holding - FY27 consensus revenue of $22.9bn (+18.9%) is a straight-line extrapolation of hyperscaler capex - and the de-rate does NOT price the break. At 34.8x FY27 core, a break takes EPS to ~$2.90 at a 17-18x industrial-glass multiple = $44-52. The structural trap: the only world where GLW gets cheap is the world where its earnings power is impaired, so there is no state in which you get the franchise discounted with growth intact. Robustness: softening the bear to $75 still gives e_FV $99 (-34pp). Screen defect: the EXHAUSTED flag is inverted - the 3y high was struck 2026-06-29, five weeks before the court, and GLW is +139% off its 52w low and +118.6% y/y. A fresh crash off a parabola scores identically to a stale recovery.
top_unverifiable: No segment decomposition of Display Technologies and Hemlock from the 10-Q. The bear FV floors the non-Optical business at ~$10-11bn revenue / mid-teens margin from aggregate arithmetic, not the segment footnote - and per the BAH segment-flooring doctrine an aggregate floor hides mix erosion. This sits directly under the bear case.
screen_defect: Require the 3y high to be >90 days old before a drawdown counts as a de-rate, or tag 'fresh-crash' separately.
